headline: Bucharest Stock Exchange lost over 400 million lei in one week. Transactions significantly reduced
summary: The Bucharest Stock Exchange closed the last July trading week with lower market capitalisation and investor activity, as listed company value fell by over 404 million lei.
why: The Bucharest Stock Exchange (BVB) is Romania's main equity market, and its benchmark indices track the value of listed Romanian companies.
